I've looked over the finished app, and it lines up with everything we settled during our conversation. The library opens to a clear personal space with All bookmarks and Read later, a search box, and an inviting empty state that walks me through saving my first link — exactly the "save it now, find it later" feeling I was after. All the flows we went through together are here: saving with details filled in, opening the site, tagging and reusing tags, searching, filtering, read-later, editing the title/description/address/tags, safe removal, duplicate prevention, and the gentle handling when things go wrong or a list is empty — and it all sticks around when I come back.

This gives me what I most wanted: one place to save a link easily and reliably find it again. I'm happy to accept this as the completed first cycle. Notes, hiding old bookmarks, and importing I'd still like down the road — please keep those recorded for a future round, but they're not part of this build and don't hold anything up.

Thank you — this is just what I hoped for.
